## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has `Signed-off-by:` (`git commit -s`, [DCO.md](../DCO.md))
- [ ] A test for the change (or why there is none)
- [ ] The documents say what the code does now (a new setting, flag or message has its line)
- [ ] No private address, host name, cluster name or token
